Why Bangalore Water Ruins Your RO

Bangalore's borewell and tanker water has very high TDS (Total Dissolved Solids). This causes filters to clog faster and damages the RO membrane.

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does RO service cost in Bangalore?▼

Our standard service charge starts from ₹499. Basic diagnosis is free, and if you get the repair done with us, visit charges are waived off. Spare parts are charged separately.

Do you use genuine spare parts?▼

Yes, we only use 100% original manufacturer spare parts (Kent, Aquaguard, etc.) with a 90-day warranty.

How fast can a technician reach my home?▼

We usually reach within 60 minutes across major Bangalore areas. For outskirt areas, it might take slightly longer.

How frequently should RO filters be replaced?▼

Due to high TDS in Bangalore water, we recommend replacing the sediment and carbon filters every 6 to 9 months to ensure the best water quality and motor life.

Which brands do you provide service for?▼

We are a multi-brand service center. We repair Kent, Aquaguard, Pureit, AO Smith, LG, Livpure, Zero B, Havells, V-Guard, and almost all other water purifier brands.

Do I need to pay any advance amount for booking?▼

No, we do not take any advance payment. You only pay after the technician visits your home, diagnoses the issue, and you approve the final quote.

What if my RO cannot be repaired?▼

If the RO is completely dead and not repairable, our technician will honestly inform you. You will only be charged the basic visit fee, and we won't force you to buy anything.
